lines.zh: 我的巡查段比哨卫长一倍，脚程也快
lines.en: My sector is twice as long; my pace matches.

lines.zh: 八只图腾在腰间碰响，像一串钥匙
lines.en: Eight totems rattle at my belt like keys.

lines.zh: 我走的是主廊，支线留给年轻人
lines.en: I walk the main corridor; branches go to the young.

lines.zh: 铁板在我脚下叫，它认得老住户
lines.en: The iron groans under me; it knows an old tenant.

lines.zh: 火从我背脊烧到肩，一路不熄
lines.en: Flame runs spine to shoulder, never out.

lines.zh: 我每一步都踩在旧脚印上，正好重合
lines.en: Each step lands exactly in my old prints.

lines.zh: 管廊尽头那盏灯，是我点着的
lines.en: That lamp at the corridor's end is mine.

lines.zh: 我走得稳，因为跌过太多次
lines.en: I walk steady because I've fallen often.

lines.zh: 八条命压着肩，脚步反倒轻
lines.en: Eight lives weigh on me; my step is lighter.

lines.zh: 我经过的阀门，都会自己转正
lines.en: Valves straighten themselves as I pass.

lines.zh: 新来的哨卫跟在我后面，学步法
lines.en: New sentries trail me, copying my stride.

lines.zh: 我沿着主管道走，从不抄近路
lines.en: I keep to the main line; no shortcuts.

lines.zh: 灰落在我肩上，像一层旧披风
lines.en: Ash settles on me like an old cloak.

lines.zh: 走完这一圈，我还能再走一圈
lines.en: Finish this lap; I could walk another.

lines.zh: 我踩过烧断的横梁，没停
lines.en: I step over a burnt beam without stopping

lines.zh: 这条廊我走了三十年，闭眼也行
lines.en: I have walked this corridor thirty years, blindfolded

lines.zh: 我在数图腾，八只，一只不少
lines.en: I count my totems: eight, none missing.

lines.zh: 老哨卫站着不动，是在听管压
lines.en: An old sentry stands still to hear the pressure.

lines.zh: 火低低地烧，省着用
lines.en: My fire burns low, rationed.

lines.zh: 我把护腕上的裂口按平，还能用
lines.en: I press a crack in my bracer shut; still usable.

lines.zh: 管廊里那股焦味，是我留下的年轮
lines.en: That scorch in the corridor is my ring count.

lines.zh: 我等着交接，可没人来换班
lines.en: I wait for relief; nobody comes to swap.

lines.zh: 八只图腾轮流亮，像在呼吸
lines.en: Eight totems glow in turn, like breathing.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看管道接缝，那里最容易裂
lines.en: I eye the seams; they split first.

lines.zh: 年轻时我也数错过，代价是一条命
lines.en: Young, I miscounted once; it cost a life.

lines.zh: 铁皮上有一道旧刀痕，我留着
lines.en: I keep an old blade mark on the plate.

lines.zh: 我把火压成一条细线，藏在掌心
lines.en: I draw my flame to a thread in my palm.

lines.zh: 管廊安静，说明还没人来送死
lines.en: Quiet corridor; nobody's come to die yet.

lines.zh: 我不用坐，站着就能歇
lines.en: No seat needed; standing is rest.

lines.zh: 我在等一个值得我起身的东西
lines.en: I wait for something worth standing up for.

lines.zh: 我把一只图腾挪到顺手的位置
lines.en: I shift one totem to where my hand can reach it

lines.zh: 火苗矮下去一截，我给它添了点
lines.en: The flame dips; I feed it a little

lines.zh: 你比上一个矮，胆子倒不小
lines.en: Shorter than the last one, but bolder.

lines.zh: 我扫你一眼，就知道你打过几次
lines.en: One look tells me your fight count.

lines.zh: 你握剑的姿势，说明你没守过岗
lines.en: Your grip says you've never held a post.

lines.zh: 别抬头找我，我就在你正上方
lines.en: Don't look up; I'm directly above you.

lines.zh: 八只图腾，你数得过来吗
lines.en: Eight totems; can you keep count?

lines.zh: 你的护甲是新的，划痕没有一道
lines.en: New armor, not one scratch.

lines.zh: 我看了你三秒，你退了半步
lines.en: Three seconds of my gaze; you step back.

lines.zh: 你在找我的弱点，我的弱点是不多
lines.en: Hunting my weakness? I keep few.

lines.zh: 你的火把照到我脸上，我眨都没眨
lines.en: Your torch hits my face; I don't blink.

lines.zh: 上一个这样看我的，编号已经撤了
lines.en: The last one who stared got struck off.

lines.zh: 你眼里有算盘，我眼里只有管廊
lines.en: You're calculating; I'm just watching the pipes.

lines.zh: 站好了，让我看看你值几条命
lines.en: Stand still; let me price your lives.

lines.zh: 少一条命，我还有七条
lines.en: One life gone; seven left.

lines.zh: 这一刀砍在旧伤上，我记仇
lines.en: That hit landed on an old scar; noted.

lines.zh: 图腾碎了一只，声音挺脆
lines.en: A totem shatters; a crisp sound.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，是给你机会
lines.en: Half a step back is a courtesy.

lines.zh: 你砍得准，可惜数不过来
lines.en: Accurate cut; too many to count.

lines.zh: 火被压了一下，立刻弹回来
lines.en: My flame is pressed down, then springs back.

lines.zh: 我肩上的铁开了口，不碍事
lines.en: My shoulder plate split; irrelevant.

lines.zh: 疼让我清醒，正好
lines.en: Pain sharpens me; good.

lines.zh: 这一下换你一条命，不够
lines.en: That costs you a life; still short.

lines.zh: 老骨头响了一声，还能撑
lines.en: Old bones creak once; still holding.

lines.zh: 你晃着金锭，我腰带响了八下
lines.en: You wave gold; my belt answers eight times.

lines.zh: 我不缺钱，我缺一个能打的对手
lines.en: I lack no coin, only a worthy opponent.

lines.zh: 拿食物来钓我？我是哨卫，不是牲口
lines.en: Bait me with food? I'm a sentry, not cattle.

lines.zh: 你把宝贝放地上，我走过去踩碎
lines.en: Lay treasure down; I'll walk over and crush it.

lines.zh: 甜味太浓了，我怀疑你下了药
lines.en: Too sweet; I suspect poison.

lines.zh: 我确实动了一下，是脚麻了
lines.en: I did twitch; my foot went numb.

lines.zh: 图腾够了，你的好意就免了
lines.en: Enough totems; keep your kindness.

lines.zh: 你想引我离岗，这招我用过
lines.en: Luring me off post? I've used that trick.

lines.zh: 我盯着你手里的东西，只想烧了它
lines.en: I stare at your offering, wanting to burn it.

lines.zh: 老哨卫不追饵，只追人
lines.en: Old sentries chase men, not bait.

lines.zh: 你退三步，我就当没看见
lines.en: Back off three steps and I'll forget it.

lines.zh: 那玩意儿再亮，也亮不过我的命
lines.en: Nothing you hold shines like my lives.

lines.zh: 我没有胃，你喂错对象了
lines.en: I have no stomach; wrong target.

lines.zh: 别用食物换路，管廊不讲价
lines.en: No food for passage; the corridor doesn't bargain.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西，我不认识
lines.en: I do not know the thing in your hand

lines.zh: 别在我岗前晃，晃久了我手痒
lines.en: Stop waving that at my post; my hand itches

lines.zh: 你撞我，像撞一堵会烧的墙
lines.en: You hit me like a wall that burns.

lines.zh: 我纹丝不动，铁板替我退了半步
lines.en: I don't budge; the floor gives instead.

lines.zh: 让路，主廊是我走的
lines.en: Make way; the main line is mine.

lines.zh: 你肩膀撞上来，烫掉一层布
lines.en: Your shoulder hits; a layer of cloth burns off.

lines.zh: 八只图腾在腰间撞响，像警告
lines.en: Eight totems clack a warning at my belt.

lines.zh: 我被挤到管壁，火苗窜了一截
lines.en: Pushed to the wall, my flame jumps higher.

lines.zh: 你力气不小，可惜站错了地方
lines.en: Strong shove; wrong place to use it.

lines.zh: 别在窄道上抢行，会一起掉下去
lines.en: No racing on the narrow walk; we both fall.

lines.zh: 我伸手扶了你一把，手是热的
lines.en: I steady you with a hand; it's hot.

lines.zh: 撞完记得看路，管廊不等人
lines.en: Watch your path after; the corridor waits for none.

lines.zh: 我这把年纪，只跟管道过日子
lines.en: At my age, I'm married to the pipeline.

lines.zh: 八条命都嫌多，还添小的
lines.en: Eight lives are plenty; no small ones.

lines.zh: 你拿两只哨卫配，只会烧穿铁板
lines.en: Pair two sentries and the floor melts.

lines.zh: 别把我当牲口拴起来
lines.en: Don't rope me like livestock.

lines.zh: 我不留后代，只留下巡查记录
lines.en: I leave records, not offspring.

lines.zh: 火里生不出更硬的火，只会更旺
lines.en: Fire breeds no heir, only more fire.

lines.zh: 你要办喜事，去别处办
lines.en: Hold your wedding elsewhere.

lines.zh: 我连图腾都嫌吵，何况孩子
lines.en: I find totems noisy; children, worse.

lines.zh: 配对这事，哨卫词典里没有
lines.en: Pairing isn't in a sentry's dictionary.

lines.zh: 我守了这么久，没守出个家
lines.en: Long service, and still no home.

lines.zh: 我不捡，管廊里的东西都有主
lines.en: I don't pick up; everything here has an owner.

lines.zh: 弯一次腰，就少看一眼管压
lines.en: One bend of the back, one lost pressure glance.

lines.zh: 你掉的铁片，踢到墙角就行
lines.en: Kick your dropped scrap to the corner.

lines.zh: 手上的火会把它烧成渣
lines.en: My hand would reduce it to slag.

lines.zh: 老规矩：掉落归战利品表，不归我
lines.en: Old rule: drops go to the loot table, not me.

lines.zh: 我拾过一回，烫穿了掌心
lines.en: I picked something up once; it burned through.

lines.zh: 别把东西塞我手里，我要握火
lines.en: Don't press things on me; I hold fire.

lines.zh: 想让我帮拿，先问管廊答不答应
lines.en: Ask the corridor if I should carry it.

lines.zh: 我不弯腰，哨卫的腰是直的
lines.en: I don't bend; a sentry's back stays straight.

lines.zh: 让它躺着，明天它还在
lines.en: Leave it lying; it'll be there tomorrow.

lines.zh: 有东西进了主廊，我起身了
lines.en: Something entered the main line; I rise.

lines.zh: 我不用看第二次，脚步就够了
lines.en: I don't need a second look; the steps suffice.

lines.zh: 你的编号我记下了，撤不掉了
lines.en: Your number is logged; can't be withdrawn.

lines.zh: 管压没变，变的是你的呼吸
lines.en: Pressure's steady; your breathing isn't.

lines.zh: 八条命对一条，我很有耐心
lines.en: Eight lives to one; I'm patient.

lines.zh: 我先封住这头，再慢慢收网
lines.en: I seal this end first, then close in.

lines.zh: 你踏进我的段，就算你倒霉
lines.en: You stepped into my sector; bad luck.

lines.zh: 老哨卫动手前，会先吹一声口哨
lines.en: Old sentries whistle once before striking.

lines.zh: 我把火提到肩上，你该明白了
lines.en: I raise flame to my shoulder; you understand.

lines.zh: 别指望跑，出口在我背后
lines.en: Don't plan to run; the exit is behind me.

lines.zh: 我挡在管道中间，正好一人宽
lines.en: I fill the pipe's width; exactly one man.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我进半步，不急
lines.en: You back one, I take half; no hurry.

lines.zh: 我数你的呼吸，比数图腾慢
lines.en: I count your breaths; slower than totems.

lines.zh: 你想从左边绕，左边是我的旧位
lines.en: Think to slip left? That's my old post.

lines.zh: 火沿着管壁爬，替你标好了路
lines.en: Flame crawls the pipe, marking your road.

lines.zh: 我站得很稳，你越急越乱
lines.en: I stand firm; your haste undoes you.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡得住一下，挡不住八下
lines.en: Your shield stops one, not eight.

lines.zh: 我把你往热的地方赶，别怪我
lines.en: I drive you toward the heat; don't blame me.

lines.zh: 你回头看退路，我只往前走
lines.en: You check your exit; I only advance.

lines.zh: 这一战我打了很久，你才刚开始
lines.en: I've fought long; you've just begun.

lines.zh: 我这一拳落下去，铁板留个坑
lines.en: My fist lands and leaves a dent in iron.

lines.zh: 你砍掉我一条命，我照样还手
lines.en: You take a life; I still swing back.

lines.zh: 我不追快，只追准
lines.en: I don't chase speed; I chase accuracy.

lines.zh: 火焰缠上你的剑柄，握得稳吗
lines.en: Flame wraps your hilt; still steady?

lines.zh: 打了这么多年，这一下最省力
lines.en: So many years, and this is my cheapest blow.

lines.zh: 第二下我打在盾沿，专挑接缝
lines.en: Second hit goes to the shield rim's seam.

lines.zh: 你退到阀门上，我替你关上
lines.en: You back onto a valve; I shut it for you.

lines.zh: 我一拳一拳，像在敲铁砧
lines.en: Blow by blow, like hammering an anvil.

lines.zh: 血溅到我手上，蒸发得很快
lines.en: Blood hits my hand and steams away.

lines.zh: 你倒下时，我的火才烧到一半
lines.en: When you fall, my flame is only half-lit.

lines.zh: 主管道的火先亮，然后是我
lines.en: The main line lights first; then me.

lines.zh: 八只图腾依次落位，我睁眼
lines.en: Eight totems click into place; I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 这次上岗，我带了双份的命
lines.en: This posting, I brought double lives.

lines.zh: 从炉膛深处爬上来，我认得这味道
lines.en: Up from the furnace's depth; I know this smell.

lines.zh: 新哨卫让开，老资格来了
lines.en: Young sentries, step aside; seniority arrives.

lines.zh: 管廊的灯一盏盏亮，替我开道
lines.en: Corridor lamps light one by one, clearing my way.

lines.zh: 我在节点上站稳，火从脚底铺开
lines.en: I settle on the node; fire spreads from my feet.

lines.zh: 图腾绕我转满一圈，才算数
lines.en: Totems must circle me once to count.

lines.zh: 铁皮上的旧痕，都是我的签名
lines.en: Every old scar on the iron is my signature.

lines.zh: 我要守的段，比你们想的都长
lines.en: My sector is longer than you think.

lines.zh: 我就是在火里铸出来的
lines.en: I was forged inside fire.

lines.zh: 掉下管廊，我砸弯了一根铁梁
lines.en: Falling, I bent an iron beam.

lines.zh: 水漫到胸口，火只剩一线
lines.en: Water to my chest; flame down to a thread.

lines.zh: 冲击把我推回岗位，正好
lines.en: The blast shoves me back to my post.

lines.zh: 箭插进甲缝，我懒得拔
lines.en: An arrow in my plate seam; I leave it.

lines.zh: 法术绕过铁甲，直接咬骨头
lines.en: Spellcraft slips my plate and bites bone.

lines.zh: 火要柴，我从不给它饱
lines.en: Fire wants fuel; I never feed it full.

lines.zh: 雷劈在管上，我替它接了半道
lines.en: Lightning hits the pipe; I take half.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有铁，也没有我的火
lines.en: No iron in the void, and no fire.
